message: Cannot use 'meta.{0}()' in '{1}' because the return type of '{1}' is not compatible with 'meta.{0}()'. Use 'meta.Proceed()', which supports any return type.
title: Cannot use a Proceed variant that is not compatible with the return type of the target method.
rationale: The method name placeholder is not quoted, unlike the other declarations, and the message gives no way forward although meta.Proceed() is always valid (TemplateExpansionContext.ProceedUserExpression.Validate accepts nameof(meta.Proceed) unconditionally). The title's 'in the current context' does not say what is incompatible.
